tasks.title: probe adopts the fixed contract client and documents API response requirements
tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe, all Behavior and Completion evidence; shared merged-contract finding in probe; Disclosure rule; Scope verification; Performance impact; Security impact; Rollout order; Acceptance evidence items 4-6

acceptance.expected: Before the first edit, record the full implementation-base SHA in task evidence; retain this BASE for every scope and performance check.

Create this disposable Git fixture script outside every repository and prove the five checks in plan.md, Scope verification, before relying on them. Record each check separately in all seven states: clean control: checks 1-5 pass, check 1 empty; allowed committed: check 1 allowed singleton, checks 2-5 pass; protected unstaged: checks 3,4 detect, checks 1,2,5 pass; protected staged: checks 2,4 detect, checks 1,3,5 pass; protected staged then worktree restored to base: git diff "$BASE" empty but checks 2,3,4 detect; protected committed with clean index/worktree: check 1 protected path, check 5 exit 1, checks 2-4 pass; protected committed then worktree restored to base: git diff "$BASE" empty but checks 1,3,4,5 detect, check 2 passes. Use an allowed file and a protected file, verify exact-path rejection against this task’s lists, and delete fixture/script afterwards.

After contract merges, read the shared finding of its full merged main SHA containing #864 and version 2.5.2; the first consumer records it and the other consumers reuse exactly that SHA. package.json and bun.lock pin that SHA together. No other dependency changes, including zod 4.6.7; request a hold if adoption needs any path outside this task's allowed list.
Exactly 1	1	package.json; the only changed line is the contract dependency pin.
Exactly 2	2	bun.lock; every added/deleted line contains pulse-contract, limited to the workspace dependency and package entry.
The contract SHA equals the independently recorded merged-contract shared finding; every other dependency and package field is unchanged.

0 failed tests on the merged fixed pin: authenticated check read is not redirected (failed read retries then succeeds, destination count 0, no destination authorization, no /checks fallback); invalid JSON from the api logs the fixed text (literal invalid JSON: response body is not valid JSON, no upstream marker). Native fetch/local runtime-built cases only.

acceptance.command: Run src/client.api-redirect.test.ts with the base pin, then restore the merged pin and lockfile
acceptance.expected: Both new test titles fail on the base pin and pass on the fixed pin; report red/green by title only, not inputs. Production source and existing tests stay unchanged.

Exit 0 under Bun 1.4.0, full 80% line coverage; existing authenticated-read, 404-fallback and version-mismatch cases in src/client.test.ts and monitored-target src/check.redirect.test.ts pass unchanged. Hold if the wider pin jump needs a protected change.

README.md and docs/configuration.md both say API reads follow no redirect, PULSE_API_URL must be the final endpoint, reads ask for uncompressed answers and refuse compressed answers. Monitored checks retain their own redirect rules; no setting added.
Required AGENTS.md handoff: start against a local fake api and exercise API reading once. Report successful check loading and the command/result; stop the service and remove scratch fixtures.

Run three times on the recorded implementation base and three on the branch, on one machine under Bun 1.4.0. Record user + system seconds rounded to 0.01 s, each median and branch-minus-base delta; no means. Expected delta under +0.1 s; fallback required above +0.3 s.

acceptance.command: git clone https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git "$SCRATCH/pulse-api"; (cd "$SCRATCH/pulse-api" && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun bench/run.ts --a "$API_MAIN" --b "$API_MAIN" --others-ref main --b-ref "probe=$TARGET_REF" --rounds 1)
acceptance.expected: Conditional fallback only after the primary threshold is exceeded. The harness runs from the scratch api checkout, never this consumer or contract repository. Record the full api main SHA as API_MAIN for both sides and the public fetchable candidate branch/SHA as TARGET_REF; Docker with Compose, git and network required. Report probe's rows and compare to api/bench/budgets.json using the plan's budget/floor rule; no api metric is expected to move. Delete the scratch checkout afterwards. Do not use --b-ref console.

acceptance.command: Review candidate security checklist and preserved consumer guards
acceptance.expected: Monitored-target redirect behavior, 404-only fallback, retries, existing guards and all production code stay unchanged. New API-read checks demonstrate redirect/header containment and fixed diagnostics; pin matches merged contract finding. Public evidence follows the disclosure rule.

acceptance.command: Review task acceptance evidence and PR text against plan.md, Disclosure rule and Security impact
acceptance.expected: Public P2 security disclosure: name location, class, impact and fix direction for security-contract-2026-11-03-1, -3, -4 and -5 only. Every security case is reported by title, class, expected outcome and budget; no working payload, response construction steps or parameters, reproduction command, crafted header value, redirect recipe or oversized-response recipe appears. Hostile inputs are built at runtime inside test code only. No new runtime or dev dependency, setting, exported name, result shape or wire version; timeout/abort behavior and default 5 MiB cap preserved.

Name #864 and inherited shared-client finding locations/classes/impacts/fix directions without inputs; report merged SHA, required checks, adoption red/green titles, documentation changes, performance medians and five separate scope outputs with fixture proof. Request a hold if any file outside this exact allowed list needs changing.

After the last commit, exact allowed list (sorted): README.md, bun.lock, docs/configuration.md, package.json, src/client.api-redirect.test.ts. Every listed path is required. No other path; inspect every allowed diff for unrelated changes.
